args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (unhealthy, error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging). Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback was completed and verified: all regions are now on v2.3.0. Follow-up needed: find the root cause in v2.3.1 and look into why an RC that was unhealthy in staging got promoted.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open. It describes the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the recovery. It also notes two things to follow up: finding the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and why v2.3.1 went to production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) was also unhealthy in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
